comment: Deterministic classification of every skill installed in this repo.
Each skill in .agents/skills (and skills-lock.json) MUST appear in at least
one bucket. A skill listed in BOTH arrays means it applies to both.
skills_manifest_test enforces that quickstarterDev + produced together cover
the installed set (no unclassified skill) and that neither names a skill that
quickstarterDev: useful when developing the quickstarter CLI. Includes ALL
Rust-related skills, because the CLI is written in Rust and Rust is
irrelevant to the produced TypeScript/React apps.
produced: installed into every generated project. Sources for each are
resolved from skills-lock.json when the produced-repo skill install runs.
both: to mark a skill as both, add its name to quickstarterDev AND produced.
